title: Advertising and Affiliate Disclosure

sections.body: This Website is free to read and is paid for by advertising, affiliate commissions on some tool pages, and the consulting practice that publishes it. No advertiser, affiliate program, or sponsor can change a verdict, a ranking, a legal status, or a case summary. If that ever changes, this page changes with it.

We display advertising served by third-party ad networks, currently Google. Those networks choose which ads you see; we do not select individual advertisers and do not review their claims. An ad appearing next to an article is not an endorsement of the advertiser. Ads are never placed above the answer block at the top of a page, because the answer is what you came for.

Some pages contain affiliate links. If you click one and buy something, we may earn a commission at no additional cost to you.

As an Amazon Associate, SRJ Consulting & Services LLC earns from qualifying purchases. Our Amazon Associates store ID is theworldofa0b-20, and Amazon links on this site carry that tag so purchases are attributed to us. Amazon sets the price; the tag does not change what you pay.

Every affiliate link carries the rel="sponsored" attribute, and every page containing one carries a visible disclosure next to the links themselves, not only here. We include tools and titles that have no affiliate program alongside those that do, and the presence or size of a commission does not affect placement, rating, ranking, or the text of anything we publish. This applies to our own books as much as to anyone else's: the SRJ series is listed separately from the independent shelf and labeled as ours.

If we sell a sponsored listing or a sponsorship of a section in future, it will be labeled "Sponsored" in plain language on the page where it appears, it will be visually distinct from editorial content, and it will not be counted or ranked as an editorial recommendation.

theworldofai.org is published by SRJ Consulting & Services LLC, which sells AI governance advisory services at srjconsultingservices.com and publishes books on the subject. Links to that practice are our own promotion and are identified as such.

We will not accept payment to remove or soften a lawsuit summary, to change a bill's reported status, to delete a critical verdict, or to publish content written by an advertiser as if it were ours. Corrections are free and immediate for anyone who reports an error, whether or not they are a customer.
